repositoryRoot.pathPolicy: Every scope and entry path is repository-relative valid UTF-8; absolute paths, symlink traversal, unsupported entries and repository escapes fail closed.

referenceVerifier.runtime: Node.js ESM using only node: built-ins

assignmentAuthority.rule: For this exact 431-file snapshot, each sorted entry path and cap pair is authoritative. Prose match descriptions are explanatory only. Any path/content/mode/capability change requires a new additive versioned manifest and independent review.
clarifications: CAP-17 owns benchmark/eval trees, benchmark core, evaluation and pilot scripts, model-routing protocol evaluation, usage telemetry, and benchmark/eval schemas.
CAP-11 is restricted to executable acceptance/assurance/return-contract modules; prompt or subagent names containing review do not acquire assurance ownership.
CAP-14 owns all shipped subagent definitions, including piagent-reviewer.
CAP-05 excludes template snapshots; template artifacts remain CAP-16.
CAP-02 owns executable guard/policy/tenant/execution/shell/redaction, MCP, security and base-policy surfaces including policy-tools and runtime-policy-smoke.
CAP-06 owns remaining runtime hooks/session/tools/registration surfaces after earlier first-match ownership.

entryContract.ordering: Ascending raw UTF-8 bytes of path.
entryContract.size: Raw file byte length as a non-negative safe integer.
entryContract.mode: stat.mode & 07777 rendered as four lowercase octal digits.
entryContract.sha256: Lowercase SHA-256 of raw file bytes.
entryContract.stability: Reference verifier opens each file no-follow, checks fd/path identity before and after read, and rejects scope symlinks, unsupported types, duplicates, missing/extra paths or races.

pathList.canonicalPayload: JSON.stringify of the sorted entry path array with no whitespace.

ownershipAggregate.canonicalPayload: JSON.stringify of entries[] with the exact key order above and no whitespace.

legacyOwnershipAggregate.disposition: The constitution-era bare aggregate had no exact assignment/canonicalization carrier and cannot be independently reproduced. It remains an opaque historical claim. This additive self-describing manifest is the canonical current-snapshot proof and does not relabel the old digest.

immutability.changeRule: Never rewrite this v1 manifest, its pinned verifier or constitution input. Source evolution requires a new versioned manifest; old evidence remains historical.
